classified.text: Viewers shall be able to browse the catalog by genre, release year, and popularity.
Users can perform keyword searches across titles, actors, and directors.
The recommendation engine shall deliver personalized title suggestions based on viewing history and explicit likes.
StreamHub shall play videos using adaptive bitrate streaming that selects the optimal quality for current network conditions.
Viewers shall be able to resume playback from the exact timestamp where they previously stopped.
The platform shall allow each user to create, edit, and delete multiple profiles within a single account.
Parents shall be able to configure parental control settings, including content rating limits, for each profile.
Viewers shall be able to add titles to, and remove titles from, a personal watchlist.
The system shall display the contents of a watchlist with thumbnail previews and short descriptions.
Subscribers shall be able to select, upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscription plans through a self‑service portal.
Users shall be able to update billing information, including credit card details and billing address.
The service shall send email notifications for successful payments, upcoming renewals, and failed transactions.
Viewers shall be able to rate titles on a five‑star scale and submit optional written reviews.
An administrator shall be able to upload new video assets together with associated metadata such as title, description, and tags.
The system shall generate and store thumbnail images for each uploaded video for use in catalogs and recommendations.
StreamHub shall enforce DRM protection on all streamed content to prevent unauthorized copying.
The platform shall log playback start, pause, stop, and error events for analytics and troubleshooting.
Viewers shall be able to switch playback between devices and continue watching without losing position.
The service shall apply content rating filters automatically based on the parental control settings of the active profile.
Users can report inappropriate or offensive content, triggering a review workflow for moderators.
Administrators shall have the ability to approve or reject user‑submitted reviews before they become public.
The system shall provide a searchable history of a user’s watched titles, including timestamps and duration.
StreamHub shall achieve 99.9% availability measured on a monthly basis, excluding scheduled maintenance windows.
The service shall scale horizontally to support up to one million concurrent video streams without degradation of quality.
Video delivery latency from the nearest CDN edge node to the client shall not exceed two seconds for initial playback.
The adaptive bitrate algorithm shall react to changes in network bandwidth within one second, selecting the appropriate quality level.
All data in transit between clients, microservices, and storage shall be encrypted using TLS 1.3 or higher.
User passwords shall be stored using a salted bcrypt hash, and payment data shall be tokenized in compliance with PCI‑DSS.
The platform shall emit structured logs, metrics, and traces to a centralized observability stack for real‑time monitoring.
Deployments shall be performed using a blue‑green strategy to ensure zero‑downtime releases.
The system shall comply with GDPR and CCPA regulations, providing mechanisms for data access, correction, and erasure upon user request.
CDN cache entries for newly uploaded or updated video assets shall be refreshed within fifteen minutes of the change.
